question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given word.**

Harangue
solution:
The correct answer is: **A lengthy and aggressive speech**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Harangue **means a forceful and lengthy speech that is usually aggressive and critical in nature. (एक सशक्त और लंबा भाषण जो आमतौर पर प्रकृति में आक्रामक और आलोचनात्मक होता है)

 
 
• **For example**: *The politician's speech turned into a passionate harangue against government policies.*
 
 
 
• The word is often used in a negative context, suggesting that the speaker is being overly critical or aggressive in their approach.
 
• The word is typically used to describe political speeches or public addresses that are meant to persuade or influence an audience.
 
• It is derived from the French word "**haranguer**" which means to address a crowd or make a speech.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• A **strict disciplinarian** refers to someone who enforces strict rules and regulations, often in a harsh or authoritarian manner. (एक सख्त अनुशासक का तात्पर्य ऐसे व्यक्ति से है जो सख्त नियमों और विनियमों को लागू करता है, अक्सर कठोर या सत्तावादी तरीके से)
 
• A **breaker of idols** refers to someone who destroys or defaces religious statues or symbols, often as an act of protest or rebellion. (कोई व्यक्ति जो अक्सर विरोध या विद्रोह के रूप में धार्मिक मूर्तियों या प्रतीकों को नष्ट या विरूपित करता है)
 
• An **airplane shed** refers to a large building or hangar used to store or house airplanes. (एक बड़ी इमारत या हैंगर को संदर्भित करता है जिसका उपयोग हवाई जहाजों को रखने या रखने के लिए किया जाता है)
